newsitem.title: FINLAND: FORECAST-Mixed views on M-Serla Q1 profit.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Mixed views on M-Serla Q1 profit.

text.p: A Reuter survey of analysts covering Finnish equities showed a 20 million markka median forecast for forest industry group Metsa-Serla Oy's first quarter 1997 profit before extraordinary items and tax:
(Profit forecasts by 13 analysts, EPS by 7 analysts).
Metsa-Serla's results are due on May 12 at 1200/0900 GMT.
In February, Metsa-Serla said it expected its business to start recovering in 1997, but the positive impact on earnings was likely to show only in 1998.
In January-April 1996, Metsa-Serla posted a 318 million markka profit after financial items.
The median of forecasts for Metsa-Serla's full-year 1997 earnings was a 457 million markka profit before extraordinary items (mean 481 million) and the range was 394-670 million markka.
Metsa-Serla's full-year 1996 profit before extraordinaries was 315 million markka.

Contributors to the survey were Alfred Berg, AG Private Bankers, Aktia Bank, Aros Securities, Erik Selin, Evli Securities, Den Danske Bank, FSB Securities, Handelsbanken, Kleinwort Benson, Merita Bank, Morgan Stanley and Opstock.
